Method of Attack: Exploitation of Apache Log4j Log4Shell vulnerability to achieve remote code execution (RCE)
Sending exploit string to vulnerable Log4j server causing bash shell to spawn and download/execute shell script
Mining Monero cryptocurrency on compromised servers
Persistence via cron subsystem on x84_64 Linux systems
Attack Vector: HTTP POST requests exploiting Log4j vulnerability via LDAP and RMI callback URLs
Indicators of Compromise: Exploit strings containing JNDI LDAP and RMI URLs
Downloaded shell script invoking bash commands via JavaScript scripting engine
Use of cron subsystem for persistence
